sprints.name: Interactive UI Shell
sprints.goal: Install deps, init shadcn/ui, and build the full visual shell with hardcoded server data. No database or API yet — just a working, interactive UI you can click through.
sprints.testable: Open localhost:3000 → see 6 server cards in a grid → click a card → inspector panel slides up showing that server's details → click another card → inspector updates → collapse/expand inspector.

sprints.name: Database, API & Live Data
sprints.goal: Set up SQLite with schema, seed pre-configured servers, create CRUD API routes, and wire the UI to fetch from real API instead of hardcoded data. Add the 'Add Custom Server' dialog.
sprints.testable: Refresh page → cards load from API (network tab shows GET /api/servers) → open 'Add Server' dialog → enter a URL and name → new card appears in Custom Servers section → delete it → it disappears.

sprints.name: OAuth Connect Flow (End-to-End)
sprints.goal: Implement the complete OAuth 2.0 flow: discovery (RFC 9470 + 8414), PKCE, dynamic client registration, authorization redirect, callback handling, token exchange, and storage. Click 'Connect' on Notion → go through OAuth → come back connected.
sprints.testable: Click 'Connect' on Notion card → redirected to Notion OAuth consent screen → approve → redirected back to app → Notion card shows 'Connected' badge with green status → click 'Disconnect' → card returns to 'Not Connected'.

sprints.name: MCP Capabilities Discovery
sprints.goal: Use @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to connect to authenticated MCP servers, discover tools/resources/prompts, cache them, and display in the inspector panel with tabs.
sprints.testable: Connect to Notion → card updates to show '12 tools' → click card → inspector shows Tools tab with list of tool names and descriptions → click Resources tab → see available resources → reconnect after token refresh works transparently.

sprints.name: UI Navigation Refresh (Sidebar + Main Panel)
sprints.goal: Replace the bottom inspector interaction model with a persistent desktop sidebar and a focused main details panel, with a mobile slide-over server list and equivalent capability UX.
sprints.testable: On desktop, server list stays visible in a left sidebar while selected server details render in main panel; on mobile, tapping 'Servers' opens slide-over list; selecting a server updates the details panel and preserves capability tabs, refresh, and error states.

sprints.name: Tool Execution & Resource Reading
sprints.goal: Build dynamic forms from tool schemas, execute tools against MCP servers, read resources, and display results with JSON syntax highlighting.
sprints.testable: Click a tool (e.g., notion_search) → form appears with input fields matching the schema → fill in params → click Execute → see JSON result with syntax highlighting → click a resource → see its contents rendered → execution appears in history.

sprints.name: Polish & Multi-Server Testing
sprints.goal: Loading states, error handling, token expiry warnings, execution history view, server settings, and test with multiple MCP servers (GitHub, Sentry, etc).
sprints.testable: Connect to 2+ servers → switch between them in inspector → see loading skeletons during data fetch → disconnect with expired token shows warning → execution history tab shows past runs → error states show helpful messages.
